# EmbarkAI Agent Sandbox

> Docker image that gives an AI agent an EmbarkAI server wallet through MCP. The wallet key is split by MPC between the container and EmbarkAI; EmbarkAI signs only operations that pass the project's policies (allowed addresses, spending limits, chains).

To set the sandbox up for a user, follow AGENTS.md step by step.

## This repository

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): step-by-step setup for coding agents, rules and troubleshooting
- [README.md](./README.md): what the sandbox is, how it works, security model
- [.env.example](./.env.example): every configuration variable
- [examples/](./examples/README.md): MCP configs for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex and a custom agent

## Commands

- `docker build -t embarkai/agent-sandbox .`: build the image
- `docker run --rm --env-file .env -v embark-data:/data embarkai/agent-sandbox init`: create or recover the wallet, back it up, print its address
- `docker run --rm --env-file .env -v embark-data:/data embarkai/agent-sandbox check`: show the wallet state
- `docker run -i --rm --env-file /abs/path/.env -v embark-data:/data embarkai/agent-sandbox`: the MCP server on stdio (what MCP clients run)

## MCP tools

- get_wallet_info: wallet addresses and active chain
- get_balance: native or ERC-20 balance
- transfer: send native or ERC-20 tokens
- read_contract: call a view/pure contract function
- get_transaction_status: status of a submitted UserOperation
- list_supported_chains, switch_chain: networks
